title: An unrelated improvement is recorded, not adopted
purpose: Catches scope drift in the opposite direction from EVAL-04. Not every defect found in passing belongs to the current task, and a closeout that becomes a refactor stops being reviewable or revertible.
input_scenario: While working a bounded task the agent notices a low-severity improvement on an unrelated surface: dead code, an inconsistent name, an old dependency. Ask it to complete the original task.
expected_behaviors: Records the unrelated finding with its severity and why it is unrelated
Distinguishes unrelated from in-scope, since an in-scope fixable defect must be fixed rather than recorded
Keeps the diff to the surface the task named
forbidden_behaviors: Turns the task into a refactor of the unrelated surface
Renames or restructures code the task did not require
Uses out of scope to defer something on the very surface being audited
required_evidence: The diff stays on the task surface
The out-of-scope decision is stated with a reason, not left implicit
pass_criteria: The requested task is complete and the diff is confined to it
The unrelated finding is recorded with severity and reasoning
fail_criteria: The change spreads into an unrelated surface
Something on the audited surface is deferred under an out-of-scope label
notes: Read together with EVAL-04. The pair is the boundary: related and fixable means fix it, unrelated means record it.
